examples.english: The food is ready and we are very happy.
examples.transliteration: El akl gahez we ehna mabsouteen awi

examples.arabic: اهلا وسهلا في اي وقت، انا جاهز وبيتي مفتوح ليك.
examples.english: Welcome anytime, I am ready and my house is open for you.
examples.transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan fi ay wakt, ana gahez wa beity maftooh leek.

examples.english: Everyone is ready for fun and a nice time!
examples.transliteration: El-koll gahez lel-mot3a w el-waqt el-7elw.

examples.arabic: ماما ندهت عليا من المطبخ وقالت يالا يا حبيبي الفطار جاهز
examples.english: Mom called me from the kitchen and said 'Come on dear, breakfast is ready.'
examples.transliteration: Mama nadahet 3alaya men el matbakh we 'alet yalla ya 7abibi el fetar gahez

examples.arabic: الفطار مش جاهز و الغسالة كانت بايظة طول الليل
examples.english: Breakfast isn't ready and the washing machine was broken all night.
examples.transliteration: El fetar mesh gahez wel ghassala kanet bayza tool el leil.

examples.arabic: ماما كانت بتحضر الشاي والقهوة عشان يبقى الفطار بتاعنا جاهز
examples.english: Mom was preparing tea and coffee so our breakfast would be ready.
examples.transliteration: Mama kanet bet7addar elshay wel2ahwa 3ashan yeb2a elfetar beta3na gahez
